title: SQLBolt: Creating Tables (Lesson 13)
description: Learn to define tables with schema data types, primary keys, and auto-incrementing IDs.

title: SQLBolt: Altering Tables (Lesson 14)
description: Practice adding, removing, and modifying table columns and constraints.

title: SQLBolt: Dropping Tables (Lesson 15)
description: Practice safe table drops and understand referential integrity cascade restrictions.

title: SQLBolt: Select Queries 101 (Lessons 1-3)
description: Master SELECT statements, WHERE clauses, and condition filtering (AND, OR, NOT).

title: SQLBolt: Filtering & Pattern Matching (Lesson 4-5)
description: Practice LIKE, ILIKE, IN, BETWEEN, and NULL comparisons across relational data.

title: LeetCode SQL 50: Recyclable and Low Fat Products
description: Simple filtering problem testing primary keys, ENUMs, and Boolean criteria.

title: SQLBolt: Multi-Table Queries with Joins (Lesson 6)
description: Master INNER JOIN logic across primary and foreign key relationships.

title: SQLBolt: Outer Joins (Lesson 7)
description: Master LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, and handling unmatched NULL row projections.

title: SQLBolt: Aggregates and GROUP BY (Lessons 10-12)
description: Practice COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX alongside GROUP BY and HAVING filters.

title: LeetCode SQL 50: Customer Who Visited but Did Not Make Any Transactions
description: Classic interview pattern combining LEFT JOIN with IS NULL filtering and COUNT aggregation.

title: LeetCode SQL 50: Consecutive Numbers
description: Test subqueries, self-joins, or LEAD/LAG window functions to identify sequences.

title: LeetCode SQL 50: Department Top Three Salaries
description: High-frequency interview question requiring DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY...).
